rules.content:
title: Voice Biometric Confidence Score Anomaly for Known Caller
status: experimental
description: Detects when a voice biometric verification score for a previously enrolled caller falls below an acceptable confidence threshold, which may indicate a deepfake or voice-clone attempt impersonating a 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: voice_authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "voice_biometric_verify"
        enrollment_status: "enrolled"
    filter_low_score:
        voice_confidence_score|lt: 70
    filter_historical_high:
        historical_avg_score|gte: 85
    condition: selection and filter_low_score and filter_historical_high
level: high
rules.title: DL-0050: Voice Biometric Confidence Score Anomaly for Known Caller (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Callback Number Mismatch for Claimed Institution
status: experimental
description: Detects when an inbound caller claims to represent a specific financial institution or internal department, but the originating ANI or callback number does not match the institution's known directory 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: voice_authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "inbound_call"
        caller_claim|contains:
            - "fraud department"
            - "security team"
            - "bank representative"
            - "account services"
    filter_ani_mismatch:
        ani_matches_directory: false
    filter_callback_mismatch:
        callback_number_verified: false
    condition: selection and (filter_ani_mismatch or filter_callback_mismatch)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0051: Callback Number Mismatch for Claimed Institution (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Audio Compression Artifacts Indicative of AI-Generated Speech
status: experimental
description: Detects audio streams exhibiting compression artifacts, spectral anomalies, or frequency-band irregularities characteristic of AI-generated or text-to-speech synthesis engines. These include unnatural
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: voice_authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "voice_stream_analysis"
    filter_artifacts:
        spectral_flatness_score|gt: 0.85
        breath_sound_detected: false
        pitch_variance|lt: 2.5
    filter_codec:
        codec_reencoding_detected: true
    condition: selection and (filter_artifacts or filter_codec)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0052: Audio Compression Artifacts Indicative of AI-Generated Speech (Sigma)
